Canary de diagnostic réseau/JDBC — tout-Java (les cellules `{bash}` sont
silencieusement ignorées par Quarto quand le FM déclare un kernel scalaire
`jupyter: java`). Docker via `ProcessBuilder` dans le conteneur de rendu
(dooD, socket de l'hôte). À retirer à l'APPLY 08.

## J1 — Pilote PostgreSQL

```{java}
%maven org.postgresql:postgresql:42.7.3
```

## J2 — Diagnostics réseau AVANT tout

```{java}
try {
    var a = java.net.InetAddress.getByName("dind");
    System.out.println("DNS-DIND=" + a.getHostAddress());
} catch (Throwable t) {
    System.out.println("DNS-DIND FAIL: " + t);
}
System.out.println("DOCKER-HOST=" + System.getenv("DOCKER_HOST"));
try {
    var p = new ProcessBuilder("docker", "version", "--format", "{{.ServerVersion}}")
            .redirectErrorStream(true).start();
    var out = new String(p.getInputStream().readAllBytes());
    p.waitFor();
    System.out.println("DOCKER-SRV=" + out.trim() + " (exit=" + p.exitValue() + ")");
} catch (Throwable t) {
    System.out.println("DOCKER-SRV FAIL: " + t);
}
```

## J3 — Lancement Postgres + readiness JDBC

```{java}
try {
    new ProcessBuilder("docker", "rm", "-f", "zz-pg")
            .redirectErrorStream(true).start().waitFor();
} catch (Throwable t) { /* toléré */ }
try {
    var p = new ProcessBuilder("docker", "run", "-d",
            "--label", "ebpro-render=true", "--name", "zz-pg",
            "-e", "POSTGRES_PASSWORD=zztest", "-e", "POSTGRES_DB=zzdb",
            "-p", "5432:5432", "postgres:17-alpine")
            .redirectErrorStream(true).start();
    var out = new String(p.getInputStream().readAllBytes());
    p.waitFor();
    System.out.println("RUN=" + out.trim() + " (exit=" + p.exitValue() + ")");
} catch (Throwable t) {
    System.out.println("RUN FAIL: " + t);
}
var props = new java.util.Properties();
props.put("user", "postgres");
props.put("password", "zztest");
props.put("connectTimeout", "5");
boolean up = false;
for (int i = 1; i <= 60; i++) {
    try (var c = java.sql.DriverManager.getConnection(
            "jdbc:postgresql://dind:5432/zzdb", props)) {
        up = true;
        System.out.println("READY-ATTEMPTS=" + i);
        break;
    } catch (Throwable t) {
        try { Thread.sleep(2000); } catch (InterruptedException e) { }
    }
}
if (!up) System.out.println("NOTREADY-60");
```

## J4 — Seed + requête via dind:5432

```{java}
try (var c = java.sql.DriverManager.getConnection(
        "jdbc:postgresql://dind:5432/zzdb", "postgres", "zztest");
     var s = c.createStatement()) {
    s.execute("CREATE TABLE zz_stop(id int primary key, name text, lat double precision)");
    s.execute("INSERT INTO zz_stop VALUES (1,'Pommier',43.125),(2,'Chene',43.130)");
    try (var r = s.executeQuery("SELECT id, name, lat FROM zz_stop ORDER BY id")) {
        var sb = new StringBuilder("PG-DIND rows=");
        while (r.next()) {
            sb.append(r.getInt(1)).append("/").append(r.getString(2))
              .append("/").append(r.getDouble(3)).append(" ");
        }
        System.out.println(sb.toString().trim());
    }
} catch (Throwable t) {
    System.out.println("PG-DIND FAIL: " + t
            + (t.getCause() != null ? " | cause=" + t.getCause() : ""));
}
```

## J5 — PostGIS sur 5433

```{java}
try {
    new ProcessBuilder("docker", "rm", "-f", "zz-pgs")
            .redirectErrorStream(true).start().waitFor();
} catch (Throwable t) { /* toléré */ }
try {
    var p = new ProcessBuilder("docker", "run", "-d",
            "--label", "ebpro-render=true", "--name", "zz-pgs",
            "-e", "POSTGRES_PASSWORD=zztest", "-e", "POSTGRES_DB=zzgis",
            "-p", "5433:5432", "postgis/postgis:17-master")
            .redirectErrorStream(true).start();
    var out = new String(p.getInputStream().readAllBytes());
    p.waitFor();
    System.out.println("RUN-PGIS=" + out.trim() + " (exit=" + p.exitValue() + ")");
} catch (Throwable t) {
    System.out.println("RUN-PGIS FAIL: " + t);
}
var props = new java.util.Properties();
props.put("user", "postgres");
props.put("password", "zztest");
props.put("connectTimeout", "5");
boolean up = false;
for (int i = 1; i <= 60; i++) {
    try (var c = java.sql.DriverManager.getConnection(
            "jdbc:postgresql://dind:5433/zzgis", props)) {
        up = true;
        System.out.println("READY-PGIS-ATTEMPTS=" + i);
        break;
    } catch (Throwable t) {
        try { Thread.sleep(2000); } catch (InterruptedException e) { }
    }
}
if (!up) System.out.println("NOTREADY-PGIS-60");
if (up) {
    try (var c = java.sql.DriverManager.getConnection(
            "jdbc:postgresql://dind:5433/zzgis", "postgres", "zztest");
         var s = c.createStatement()) {
        s.execute("CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis");
        try (var r = s.executeQuery(
                "SELECT PostGIS_Version(), ST_Distance("
              + "ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(6.032,43.125),4326)::geography, "
              + "ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(6.040,43.130),4326)::geography)")) {
            r.next();
            System.out.println("PGIS=" + r.getString(1)
                    + " distance_m=" + r.getDouble(2));
        }
    } catch (Throwable t) {
        System.out.println("PGIS FAIL: " + t
                + (t.getCause() != null ? " | cause=" + t.getCause() : ""));
    }
}
```

## J6 — Nettoyage

```{java}
try {
    var p = new ProcessBuilder("docker", "stop", "zz-pg", "zz-pgs")
            .redirectErrorStream(true).start();
    var out = new String(p.getInputStream().readAllBytes());
    p.waitFor();
    System.out.println("STOP-OUT=" + out.trim() + " (exit=" + p.exitValue() + ")");
} catch (Throwable t) {
    System.out.println("STOP FAIL: " + t);
}
System.out.println("CLEANED");
```
